sort.title_vi: Xếp mỗi câu vào đúng loại câu điều kiện

groups.name: Type 0
items: If you freeze water, it turns into ice.
If people don't sleep, they get tired.
Chocolate melts if you leave it in the sun.
groups.rule_vi: **Loại 0**: điều luôn đúng, sự thật; **hai vế đều hiện tại đơn**: ==you freeze water, it turns into ice==. __Thay 'if' bằng 'when' mà nghĩa không đổi là loại 0.__

groups.name: Type 1
items: If you apply early, you'll get an interview.
If Mai practises more, she will win.
We'll miss the bus if we don't hurry.
groups.rule_vi: **Loại 1**: việc có thể xảy ra; **If + hiện tại đơn, will + V**: ==you apply early, you'll get==. __Thấy will/'ll ở vế chính là loại 1.__

groups.name: Type 2
items: If I were rich, I'd travel the world.
If I had wings, I would fly to school.
She would apply if she spoke English.
groups.rule_vi: **Loại 2**: điều không có thật ở hiện tại; **If + quá khứ đơn, would + V**: ==If I were rich, I'd travel==. __Thấy were/had và would/'d là loại 2.__

unjumble.sentence: If you work hard, you will have a successful career.
unjumble.hint_vi: Loại 1: If + hiện tại đơn, will + V.
unjumble.why_vi: **Loại 1: If + hiện tại đơn, will + V** → ==If you work hard==, ==you will have== a successful career. __Mệnh đề if đứng đầu thì có dấu phẩy.__

unjumble.sentence: If I were you, I would apply for that job.
unjumble.hint_vi: Loại 2 khuyên bảo: If I were you, I would...
unjumble.why_vi: Lời khuyên **loại 2: If I were you, I would + V** → ==I would apply for that job==. __Nhớ cụm apply for + công việc.__

unjumble.sentence: If you drop an egg, it usually breaks.
unjumble.hint_vi: Loại 0: điều luôn xảy ra, hai vế đều hiện tại đơn.
unjumble.why_vi: **Loại 0**: hai vế hiện tại đơn; trạng từ ==usually== đứng trước động từ thường: it usually breaks. __Trạng từ tần suất đứng trước động từ thường.__

unjumble.sentence: What would you do if you lost your job?
unjumble.hint_vi: Câu hỏi loại 2: What would you do if + quá khứ đơn?
unjumble.why_vi: Câu hỏi **loại 2: What would you do if + quá khứ đơn?** → ==What would you do if you lost your job?== __Câu hỏi đặt What would you do lên đầu.__

unjumble.sentence: You will get the job if you have more experience.
unjumble.hint_vi: Loại 1, mệnh đề if đứng sau nên không có dấu phẩy.
unjumble.why_vi: **Loại 1**, mệnh đề if đứng sau: ==You will get the job== ==if you have more experience==. __If đứng giữa câu thì không có dấu phẩy.__

truefalse.s: If it will be sunny tomorrow, we'll go to the beach.
truefalse.fix: If it is sunny tomorrow, we'll go to the beach.
truefalse.why_vi: Không dùng will trong mệnh đề if → ==If it will be sunny== sửa thành **If it is sunny**. __Vế if của loại 1 luôn ở hiện tại đơn.__

truefalse.s: If I were a teacher, I would never give homework.
truefalse.fix: If I were a teacher, I would never give homework.
truefalse.why_vi: Đúng: **loại 2** (điều không có thật): ==If I were a teacher, I would never give==. __Loại 2 dùng were cho mọi ngôi.__

truefalse.s: If babies are hungry, they cry.
truefalse.fix: If babies are hungry, they cry.
truefalse.why_vi: Đúng: **loại 0** nói điều luôn xảy ra; hai vế đều hiện tại đơn: ==are hungry==, ==cry==.

truefalse.s: If I have a million dollars, I would buy a house by the sea.
truefalse.fix: If I had a million dollars, I would buy a house by the sea.
truefalse.why_vi: Vế sau có ==would buy== → loại 2, vế if phải chia quá khứ: **If I had**. __Nhìn vế chính để biết loại câu điều kiện.__

truefalse.s: If Lan gets the job, she will move to Đà Nẵng.
truefalse.fix: If Lan gets the job, she will move to Đà Nẵng.
truefalse.why_vi: Đúng: **loại 1**, If + hiện tại đơn (==gets==), will + V (==will move==).

truefalse.s: My mum would be happy if I tidy my room every day.
truefalse.fix: My mum would be happy if I tidied my room every day.
truefalse.why_vi: Vế chính có ==would be happy== → loại 2, vế if dùng quá khứ: **tidied**. __Mệnh đề if đứng sau vẫn phải chia đúng loại.__

truefalse.s: If I were you, I will apply for the job.
truefalse.fix: If I were you, I would apply for the job.
truefalse.why_vi: ==If I were you== là loại 2 → vế sau dùng **would apply**, không dùng will. __Thuộc lòng cả cụm: If I were you, I would….__

truefalse.s: If you leave ice cream in the sun, it melts.
truefalse.fix: If you leave ice cream in the sun, it melts.
truefalse.why_vi: Đúng: **loại 0** (sự thật hiển nhiên), hai vế hiện tại đơn: ==leave==, ==melts==.

exam.intro_vi: Đề Chuyên Ngoại ngữ có 6 câu hoàn thành hội thoại; đề chung vào lớp 10 cũng có câu chọn lời đáp phù hợp. Cậu đọc lời người A rồi chọn câu B đáp lại tự nhiên nhất.
exam.tip_vi: Mẹo: xác định A đang làm gì (khen, nhờ, xin lỗi, khuyên, hỏi ý kiến) rồi chọn câu đáp đúng chức năng, không chỉ đúng ngữ pháp.

items.q:
A: I've just been offered a place at the summer art camp!
B: ______
options: Never mind. Better luck next time.
items.explain_vi: A báo tin vui (==I've just been offered a place==) → B chúc mừng: **Congratulations! You really deserve it.** __Never mind, That's a pity dùng cho tin buồn.__

items.q:
A: Would you mind helping me with my job application form?
B: ______
options: Not at all. Let me have a look.
No, thanks. I can do it myself.
items.explain_vi: ==Would you mind helping me…?== nghĩa là 'Bạn có phiền…?' → đồng ý giúp thì nói **Not at all** (không phiền gì). __Trả lời Yes nghĩa là có phiền, dễ nhầm.__

items.q:
A: If I were you, I'd ask the teacher for some advice.
B: ______
items.explain_vi: A đưa lời khuyên (==If I were you, I'd…==) → B cảm ơn và đồng ý: **That's a good idea. Thanks.** __Same to you dùng để đáp lời chúc.__

items.q:
A: I'm sorry, I can't finish the report today. My computer has broken down.
B: ______
options: Never mind. You can send it to me tomorrow.
items.explain_vi: A xin lỗi (==I'm sorry, I can't finish==) → B thông cảm: **Never mind.** __You're welcome là đáp lời cảm ơn, không phải lời xin lỗi.__

items.q:
A: What would you do if you were offered a job abroad?
B: ______
options: I would accept it. It would be a great experience.
I will go there last year.
items.explain_vi: Câu hỏi ==What would you do if…?== (loại 2) → trả lời **I would + V**: I would accept it. __Câu hỏi What không trả lời bằng Yes/No.__

exam.intro_vi: Phần nghe của đề chuyên Anh của Sở có 20 câu; một dạng hay gặp là nghe một thông báo rồi điền từ hoặc số vào phiếu ghi chú. Ở đây cậu nghe 1 bài và điền 5 chỗ trống.
exam.tip_vi: Mẹo: đọc phiếu ghi chú trước khi nghe, đoán chỗ trống cần số, tên hay danh từ. Viết số bằng chữ số, kiểm tra chính tả.
exam.script: Good morning, everyone. This is an announcement from the school office about our Career Day. This year, Career Day will be held on Saturday the 14th of November in the school hall. It starts at half past eight and finishes at half past eleven. More than twenty guests will come to talk about their jobs, including a pilot, a chef, two doctors and a famous game designer. If you want to ask the guests questions, please prepare them before the day. There will also be a special workshop on how to write a CV. Places are limited to 40 students, so if you want to join, you need to apply before Wednesday. To apply, just send an email to Ms Hoa, the school librarian. Students who help at the event will receive a certificate. Please wear your school uniform on the day. If it rains, the outdoor activities will move to the sports hall. Thank you, and we hope to see you there!
exam.text:
CAREER DAY
• Date: Saturday, [1] November
• Place: the school [2]
• More than 20 guests, e.g. a pilot, a chef and a game [3]
• CV workshop: only [4] places – apply before Wednesday
• To apply: email Ms Hoa, the school [5]

items.explain_vi: Bài nói: =="Saturday the 14th of November"== → **14**. __Ngày tháng chỉ cần viết số.__
Bài nói: =="in the school hall"== → **hall** (hội trường). __Sports hall là nơi dự phòng khi trời mưa, đừng nhầm.__
Bài nói: =="a famous game designer"== → **designer**. __Đề có sẵn 'game' nên chỉ điền từ sau.__
Bài nói: =="Places are limited to 40 students"== → **40**. __Đừng nhầm với 'twenty guests'.__
Bài nói: =="Ms Hoa, the school librarian"== → **librarian** (cô thủ thư).

exam_easy.intro_vi: Dạng này có trong đề Chuyên Ngoại ngữ và đề chung vào lớp 10. Cậu đọc câu của người A rồi chọn câu trả lời của người B hợp nhất. Mỗi câu chỉ có một đáp án đúng.
exam_easy.tip_vi: Mẹo: câu hỏi 'What…?' cần câu trả lời có thông tin, không trả lời Yes/No. Ai cảm ơn thì đáp 'You're welcome'; ai chúc mình thì đáp 'Thank you'.

items.q:
A: What does your father do?
B: ______
items.explain_vi: ==What does your father do?== là hỏi nghề nghiệp → **He's a bus driver.** __He's fine trả lời câu hỏi sức khoẻ.__

items.q:
A: Thanks for helping me fill in this form.
B: ______
items.explain_vi: A cảm ơn (==Thanks for helping me==) → đáp lại: **You're welcome.** (không có gì) __Học cặp: Thanks – You're welcome.__

items.q:
A: What will you do if it rains on Sunday?
B: ______
options: I'll stay at home and read books.
items.explain_vi: ==What will you do if…?== (loại 1) → trả lời **I'll + V**: I'll stay at home and read books. __Không trả lời Yes/No, không dùng quá khứ.__

items.q:
A: I want to be a vet when I grow up.
B: ______
options: That's great! You really love animals.
items.explain_vi: A kể ước mơ ==I want to be a vet== → B khen, động viên: **That's great! You really love animals.** __Yes, I'd love to dùng để nhận lời mời.__

items.q:
A: Good luck with your job interview tomorrow!
B: ______
options: Thank you! I'll do my best.
items.explain_vi: Ai chúc mình (==Good luck!==) thì mình cảm ơn: **Thank you! I'll do my best.** __You're welcome là đáp lời cảm ơn, không đáp lời chúc.__

exam_easy.intro_vi: Phần nghe trong đề chuyên Anh của Sở có dạng nghe rồi điền vào phiếu ghi chú. Bài nghe ở đây ngắn và chậm. Cậu nghe rồi điền một từ hoặc một số vào 5 chỗ trống.
exam_easy.tip_vi: Mẹo: đọc 5 dòng ghi chú trước khi nghe, đoán chỗ nào cần số, chỗ nào cần danh từ. Số thì viết bằng chữ số, ví dụ 7.
exam_easy.script: Hello, everyone. My name is Lan. Today I want to tell you about my mother's job. My mother is a nurse. She works at a big hospital in the city centre. She starts work at seven o'clock in the morning. She goes to work by bus. Her job is not easy. She looks after sick children. She works five days a week, from Monday to Friday. She loves her job because she likes helping people. My mother always says, if you want to be a good nurse, you must be kind and patient. I want to be a nurse too. If I study hard, I will go to a medical school. Thank you for listening.
exam_easy.text:
MY MOTHER'S JOB
• Job: a [1]
• Starts work at: [2] a.m.
• Goes to work by: [3]
• Works [4] days a week
• A good nurse must be kind and [5]

items.explain_vi: Bài nói: =="My mother is a nurse."== → **nurse** (y tá).
Bài nói: =="She starts work at seven o'clock in the morning."== → **7**. __Đề có sẵn 'a.m.' nên chỉ điền số.__
Bài nói: =="She goes to work by bus."== → **bus**. __by + phương tiện, không có a/the.__
Bài nói: =="She works five days a week, from Monday to Friday."== → **5**.
Bài nói: =="you must be kind and patient"== → **patient** (kiên nhẫn). __Nghe từ ngay sau 'kind and'.__

exam_plus.intro_vi: Câu hội thoại khó trong đề Chuyên Ngoại ngữ thường kiểm tra lời đáp lịch sự, thành ngữ giao tiếp và câu bẫy như 'Do you mind…?'. Nhiều phương án nghe tự nhiên, nhưng chỉ một câu hợp ngữ cảnh.
exam_plus.tip_vi: Mẹo: với 'Do/Would you mind…?', đáp 'Not at all' là đồng ý. Kiểm tra cả thì: hỏi bằng 'would' thì đáp bằng 'would'.

items.q:
A: I'm thinking of turning down the job offer from that tech company.
B: ______
options: Never mind. There's always next time.
If I were you, I'd think it over first. It's a great chance.
If I am you, I will accept it at once.
Don't mention it. It was my pleasure.
items.explain_vi: A đang phân vân (==I'm thinking of turning down==) → B khuyên: **If I were you, I'd think it over first.** __'If I am you' sai ngữ pháp; Never mind dùng để an ủi.__

items.q:
A: Do you mind if I leave work an hour early today? My son is ill.
B: ______
options: Never mind. It's not your fault.
Not at all. I hope he gets better soon.
items.explain_vi: ==Do you mind if I…?== nghĩa là 'Bạn có phiền không?' → đồng ý thì đáp **Not at all.** __'Yes, of course' nghĩa là có phiền, mâu thuẫn với 'Go ahead'.__

items.q:
A: I've been looking for a job for six months, and I'm starting to lose hope.
B: ______
options: Well done! Keep up the good work.
Lucky you! I wish I had so much free time.
Hang in there. Something will turn up soon.
Same here. I've just got a new job.
items.explain_vi: A đang nản (==starting to lose hope==) → B động viên: **Hang in there. Something will turn up soon.** __Lucky you thiếu tế nhị, Same here mâu thuẫn với vế sau.__

items.q:
A: What would you do if your boss asked you to work every weekend?
B: ______
options: I'd probably start looking for another job.
I'll ask him for a pay rise.
I did it once last year.
items.explain_vi: ==What would you do if your boss asked…?== (loại 2) → đáp **I'd + V**: I'd probably start looking for another job. __I'll là loại 1; would have refused là quá khứ.__

items.q:
A: You should apply for the manager position. You're more than qualified.
B: ______
options: Thanks for the vote of confidence! Maybe I'll give it a go.
items.explain_vi: A khen B ==more than qualified== → B cảm ơn sự tin tưởng: **Thanks for the vote of confidence! Maybe I'll give it a go.** __Congratulations sai vì chưa có kết quả.__

exam_plus.intro_vi: Bài nghe khó trong đề chuyên thường có thông tin gây nhiễu: người nói nhắc một chi tiết rồi sửa lại. Cậu nghe bài dài hơn và điền 5 chỗ trống, mỗi chỗ một từ hoặc một số.
exam_plus.tip_vi: Mẹo: chú ý các từ báo sửa thông tin như 'but', 'not', 'has been moved', 'rather than'. Thông tin đúng thường đến sau những từ này.
exam_plus.script: Good afternoon, and welcome to the job corner on Youth Radio. Today we have news about the Green City Summer Internship, which is open to students aged fifteen to eighteen. Interns will spend four weeks working at the city's recycling centre. The organisers first planned to start on the first of July, but because of the exams, the start date has been moved to the eighth. Interns will work from Monday to Thursday, not on Fridays as many people expected, and they will receive a small allowance of fifty thousand dong a day, plus a free lunch. The organisers are looking for young people who are responsible and good at teamwork. You don't need any previous experience. If you are interested, you should apply online rather than by post, and the deadline is the twentieth of June. If a lot of people apply, the best candidates will be invited to an interview, which will take place at the City Library, not at the recycling centre. So, if I were you, I would start my application today!
exam_plus.text:
GREEN CITY SUMMER INTERNSHIP
• Age: 15–18
• Length: [1] weeks
• Start date: [2] July
• Working days: Monday to [3]
• Interns should be responsible and good at [4]
• Interviews: at the City [5]

items.explain_vi: Bài nói: =="Interns will spend four weeks"== → **4**.
Ngày 1 bị đổi: =="the start date has been moved to the eighth"== → **8**. __Nghe 'has been moved to' để lấy thông tin mới.__
=="from Monday to Thursday, not on Fridays"== → **Thursday**. __Friday bị phủ định bằng 'not', là bẫy.__
Bài nói: =="responsible and good at teamwork"== → **teamwork**. __Đề đã có 'responsible', chỉ điền từ sau 'good at'.__
=="at the City Library, not at the recycling centre"== → **Library**. __Thông tin sau 'not' là sai, loại ngay.__

paper_plus.instruction_vi: Câu 1–2: viết dạng đúng của từ in hoa (có thể phải đổi từ 2 lần hoặc thêm tiền tố). Câu 3–4: viết tiếp câu thứ hai sao cho nghĩa không đổi. Câu 5–6: khoanh A, B, C hoặc D.

items.q: ______ among young people has risen sharply since several factories in the area closed down. (EMPLOY)
items.explain_vi: Đầu câu cần **danh từ** làm chủ ngữ; nhà máy ==closed down== → nạn thất nghiệp tăng → **Unemployment**. __Nhớ viết hoa vì đứng đầu câu.__

items.q: Many school leavers have ______ expectations about their first salary, so they are often disappointed when they receive their first payslip. (REAL)
items.explain_vi: Trước ==expectations== cần **tính từ**; ==often disappointed== cho thấy kỳ vọng không thực tế → **unrealistic**. __Họ từ: real, realistic, unrealistic.__

items.q: I don't have enough experience, so I can't apply for the job. → If I ______
items.answer: had enough experience, I could apply for the job.
accept: had enough experience, I could apply for the job
had enough experience, I would be able to apply for the job.
had enough experience, I would be able to apply for the job
had enough experience, I'd be able to apply for the job.
had enough experience, I'd be able to apply for the job
items.explain_vi: Hiện tại không có thật → **câu điều kiện loại 2**: If + quá khứ, could + V → ==If I had enough experience, I could apply for the job.== __Câu gốc phủ định thì câu If khẳng định.__

items.q: Work harder or you won't get a pay rise. → Unless ______
items.answer: you work harder, you won't get a pay rise.
accept: you work harder, you won't get a pay rise
you work harder, you will not get a pay rise.
you work harder, you will not get a pay rise
items.explain_vi: **Unless** nghĩa là 'if … not' → ==Unless you work harder, you won't get a pay rise.== __Sau Unless dùng động từ khẳng định, không thêm not.__

items.q: After months of searching, Hà finally ______ a job at an international school.
items.explain_vi: Collocation **land a job**: kiếm được việc (sau khi tìm vất vả) → **A. landed**; dấu hiệu ==After months of searching==. __Học thuộc: land a job, get a job.__

items.q: Because of falling sales, the company had to ______ two hundred workers last month.
items.explain_vi: **lay off**: cho nghỉ việc vì công ty khó khăn → **A**; lý do là ==falling sales==. __take on là tuyển thêm, nghĩa ngược lại.__

hints.d10C1: động từ nguyên mẫu (sau 'plans to'; thêm đuôi -en)
hints.d10C2: động từ (chủ ngữ số nhiều 'Scientists'; thêm đuôi -ify)
hints.d10C3: động từ nguyên mẫu (sau 'didn't'; thêm đuôi -ise)
hints.d10C4: động từ nguyên mẫu (sau 'Can you'; thêm đuôi -en)

reading_gloss: được trả tiền, được trả lương
writing_starters: When I grow up, I want to be …
A good … needs skills such as …
If I study hard, I will …

part1.intro_vi: Nghe Nam và Mai nói về nghề nghiệp mơ ước. Chọn đáp án đúng cho mỗi câu hỏi.

script.t: Mai, what do you want to be in the future?
I want to be a vet. I love animals, and I have two cats and a dog at home.
That's a great job. But you need to study for a long time, right?
Yes, about five years at university. What about you, Nam?
My ambition is to be a chef. I cook dinner for my family every Sunday.
Wow! What's your best dish?
Fried rice with eggs. My dad says it's better than the restaurant's!
If you open a restaurant one day, I'll go there every week.
Thanks! If I had enough money, I would open one next to our school.
Good idea. Then all the teachers would eat there too!

items.q: What does Mai want to be?
items.explain_vi: Mai nói: =="I want to be a vet. I love animals."== → **a vet**. __Chef là ước mơ của Nam, đừng nhầm người.__

items.q: What pets does Mai have?
items.explain_vi: Mai: =="I have two cats and a dog at home."== → **two cats and a dog**. __Nghe kỹ số lượng đi với từng con vật.__

items.q: How long does Mai need to study at university?
items.explain_vi: Mai: =="Yes, about five years at university."== → **five years**.

items.q: When does Nam cook for his family?
items.explain_vi: Nam: =="I cook dinner for my family every Sunday."== → **every Sunday**.

items.q: Where would Nam like to open a restaurant?
items.explain_vi: Nam: =="If I had enough money, I would open one next to our school."== → **next to their school**. __'our school' trong bài thành 'their school' trong đáp án.__

part2.intro_vi: Nghe Linh kể về công việc của dì mình. Điền vào mỗi chỗ trống MỘT hoặc HAI từ, hoặc một con số.
part2.script: Hi, I'm Linh. Today I'm going to tell you about my aunt's job. She works at the zoo in Hanoi. She is a zookeeper, and she is responsible for the elephants and the monkeys. She gets up very early, at five o'clock, because the animals need their breakfast! My aunt has worked there for 12 years, so she has a lot of experience. She says the most important skill in her job is watching carefully, because animals can't tell you when they are ill. Her job isn't easy, and she works on Saturdays too, but she never wants to change it. If I visit the zoo next month, she will show me the baby elephant.
part2.text:
MY AUNT'S JOB
• Job: a [1]
• Looks after: the elephants and the [2]
• Has worked there for: [3] years
• Most important skill: watching [4]
• Next month: Linh will see the baby [5]

items.explain_vi: =="She is a zookeeper."== → **zookeeper**. __Viết liền hoặc tách 'zoo keeper' đều được.__
=="she is responsible for the elephants and the monkeys"== → **monkeys**. __Đề có 'the elephants' nên điền con vật còn lại.__
=="My aunt has worked there for 12 years"== → **12**. __Đừng nhầm với 'five o'clock' (giờ dậy).__
=="the most important skill in her job is watching carefully"== → **carefully**.
=="she will show me the baby elephant"== → **elephant**.

part1.intro_vi: Nghe Linh và Tom nói về một công việc hè mà Tom muốn ứng tuyển. Chọn đáp án đúng cho mỗi câu hỏi.

script.t: Hi Tom. You look busy. What are you writing?
An application. The summer camp near the lake is looking for teenage helpers, and I'd like to apply.
Oh, the camp for little kids? What would you have to do?
Mostly play games with them and help at lunchtime. They want people who are cheerful and responsible.
Well, you're great with your little cousins, so you'd be perfect. Is it paid?
Yes, a bit. They pay 100,000 dong a day. Oh no, sorry, I read it wrong. It's 150,000 for a full day and 100,000 for a morning.
Not bad. How many days a week?
Three. Monday, Wednesday and Friday. But if they ask me to work more, I'll probably say yes.
Do you need any experience?
Not really, but they want a letter from a teacher. I'm going to ask Mr Brown tomorrow.
Good idea. He knows you well. When's the deadline?
This Friday, so I can't wait any longer. If I don't send it by then, I'll lose my chance.

items.q: What job is Tom applying for?
options: looking after young children at a camp
working at a cafe near the lake
teaching English at a language centre
items.explain_vi: Tom nói trại hè cần người giúp, việc chính là =="play games with them and help at lunchtime"== → **looking after young children at a camp**. __Gom ý cả đoạn, không chỉ một từ.__

items.q: Why does Linh think Tom would be good at the job?
options: He has worked at a camp before.
He gets on well with his young cousins.
He is good at cooking lunch.
items.explain_vi: Linh: =="you're great with your little cousins, so you'd be perfect"== → **He gets on well with his young cousins.** __Mr Brown chưa giới thiệu gì, chỉ là người Tom sẽ nhờ.__

items.q: How much will Tom earn for a full day?
items.explain_vi: Tom đọc nhầm rồi sửa: =="It's 150,000 for a full day and 100,000 for a morning."== → **150,000 dong**. __Nghe 'sorry, I read it wrong' thì lấy số sau.__

items.q: What does Tom need from Mr Brown?
options: a letter to support his application
items.explain_vi: Tom: =="they want a letter from a teacher. I'm going to ask Mr Brown tomorrow."== → **a letter to support his application**.

items.q: What do we learn about the deadline?
options: Tom has only a few days left to apply.
Tom can send the application next week.
The camp has changed it to Monday.
items.explain_vi: Tom: =="This Friday, so I can't wait any longer."== → **Tom has only a few days left to apply.** __Đáp án diễn đạt lại ý, không lặp từ của bài.__

part2.intro_vi: Nghe quản lý hiệu sách hướng dẫn các tình nguyện viên mới trong ngày đầu tiên. Điền vào mỗi chỗ trống MỘT hoặc HAI từ, hoặc một con số.
part2.script: Good morning, and thank you for joining our team of weekend volunteers at Sunshine Bookshop. Let me explain a few things before we open. First, please always sign in at the front desk when you arrive, not at the back door, even if you come in that way. Today, you'll be responsible for the children's corner on the second floor. You'll help kids find books and tidy the shelves. Your break is at half past twelve. Oh, sorry, I've just checked, and today it's at one o'clock, because we're very busy at lunchtime. Please wear the green T-shirt we gave you, not your school uniform. If you have a problem, ask my colleague Anna, who has worked here for 6 years. She knows where everything is. And remember, if you do well this summer, you'll get a free book every month until the end of the year. Right, any questions? No? Then let's open the doors.
part2.text:
SUNSHINE BOOKSHOP: WEEKEND VOLUNTEERS
• Sign in at: the front [1]
• Work in: the children's corner, [2] floor
• Wear: a green [3]
• Problems: ask Anna, who has worked there for [4] years
• Reward if you do well: a free [5] every month

items.explain_vi: =="always sign in at the front desk… not at the back door"== → **desk**. __Thông tin sau 'not' là sai.__
=="the children's corner on the second floor"== → **second**.
=="Please wear the green T-shirt we gave you, not your school uniform."== → **T-shirt**.
=="my colleague Anna, who has worked here for 6 years"== → **6**. __Giờ nghỉ đổi từ 12:30 sang 1:00, không liên quan câu này.__
=="you'll get a free book every month"== → **book**.

part1.intro_vi: Nghe Mai và Nam nói về lựa chọn nghề nghiệp của chị họ Nam. Chú ý ý kiến, thái độ và những điều có thể suy ra.

script.t: Nam, didn't your cousin finish university last month? Has she found a job yet?
Actually, she's had two offers. One from a big bank and one from a small animation studio.
Wow. Let me guess, she took the bank job. It must pay much better.
It does, almost twice as much. But she turned it down. She's starting at the studio on Monday.
Really? I'd find it hard to say no to that much money. Were her parents upset?
Her dad was, at first. He kept saying that if she worked at the bank, she'd never have to worry about money. But her mum supported her from the start.
So what made her choose the studio?
Well, she's been drawing since she was little, and her ambition has always been to make cartoons. She said that if she spent all day looking at numbers, she'd be bored within a month.
I get that. But isn't it a bit risky? Small companies sometimes close down.

That's what I said! But she pointed out that she'll learn far more there, because there are only twelve people and everyone does a bit of everything. In a bank, she'd just be one of thousands of employees.
That's a fair point. Experience like that could be really useful later in her career.
Exactly. And if it doesn't work out, she can always apply to a bank in a year or two.
Honestly, I admire her. I'm not sure I'd be that brave. What about you? Would you do the same?
Probably, yes. I'd rather earn less and enjoy what I do.

items.q: What did Mai guess about the cousin's decision?
options: She had chosen the job with the higher salary.
She had decided to carry on studying.
She was still waiting for an offer.
She had chosen the studio because of her parents.
items.explain_vi: Mai đoán: =="she took the bank job. It must pay much better."== → **She had chosen the job with the higher salary.** __Câu hỏi hỏi lời đoán của Mai, không phải sự thật.__

items.q: How did the cousin's parents react to her choice?
options: Her father disagreed at first, but her mother supported her.
Her mother was worried, but her father agreed.
Both of them supported her immediately.
items.explain_vi: =="Her dad was, at first… But her mum supported her from the start."== → **Her father disagreed at first, but her mother supported her.** __Chú ý 'at first' và 'from the start'.__

items.q: According to the cousin, what is the main advantage of working at the studio?
options: She will earn more money there.
The company is safer than a bank.
She will work with thousands of people.
She will develop a wider range of skills.
items.explain_vi: Ở studio chỉ có 12 người, =="everyone does a bit of everything"== → **She will develop a wider range of skills.** __Lương cao hơn là ở ngân hàng, loại A.__

items.q: What is Mai's attitude towards the cousin by the end of the conversation?
options: She thinks she has made a serious mistake.
She feels a little jealous of her.
items.explain_vi: Cuối bài Mai nói: =="I admire her. I'm not sure I'd be that brave."== → **She admires her courage.** __Hỏi thái độ cuối bài thì nghe câu cuối của người đó.__

items.q: What can we learn about Nam?
options: He would prefer a well-paid job, even a boring one.
He hopes to work at a bank one day.
He values enjoying his work more than a high salary.
He plans to join his cousin at the studio.
items.explain_vi: Nam: =="I'd rather earn less and enjoy what I do."== → **He values enjoying his work more than a high salary.** __I'd rather A (than B): thích A hơn B.__

part2.intro_vi: Nghe một doanh nhân trẻ kể chuyện lập nghiệp, chú ý thông tin gây nhiễu. Điền vào mỗi chỗ trống MỘT hoặc HAI từ, hoặc một con số.
part2.script: Hello, everyone. When your head teacher asked me to talk about my career, I almost turned the invitation down, because I'm only 24. But here's my story. I started my first business when I was 16. Many people think I sold clothes, but I actually made handmade notebooks and sold them to students at my school. At first, I made about twenty a week, and I was responsible for everything, from buying paper to delivering orders on my bike. My biggest mistake was setting my prices too low. I thought cheap notebooks would sell faster, but I ended up working every night and earning almost nothing. Then a colleague of my mum's, who ran a small shop, gave me some great advice. She told me that customers will happily pay more if you explain the story behind your product. So I started adding a little card to every notebook. Today, my company employs fifteen people. If I could give my younger self one piece of advice, it wouldn't be to work harder. It would be to ask for help earlier. Now, does anyone have any questions?
part2.text:
TALK: FROM SCHOOL BUSINESS TO COMPANY
• Age when she started her first business: [1]
• First product: handmade [2]
• Biggest mistake: her prices were too [3]
• Useful advice came from a woman who ran a small [4]
• Advice to her younger self: ask for [5] earlier

items.explain_vi: =="I started my first business when I was 16."== → **16**. __24 là tuổi hiện nay, là thông tin nhiễu.__
Không phải quần áo: =="I actually made handmade notebooks"== → **notebooks**. __'Many people think… but actually' báo hiệu thông tin bị sửa.__
=="My biggest mistake was setting my prices too low."== → **low**.
=="a colleague of my mum's, who ran a small shop"== → **shop**.
Không phải làm chăm hơn: =="It would be to ask for help earlier."== → **help**. __'it wouldn't be… It would be…' cho biết đáp án nằm ở vế sau.__
